property_summary: For any caller address that currently has zero tokenBalance and that is a Bank supporting the token, calling airDrop will result in that caller having tokenBalance == 20 in the correct contract; the mutant inverting hasNoBalance blocks zero-balance callers and thus violates this by leaving some callers at 0.
change_summary: Invert hasNoBalance to require the caller already has a positive balance, allowing only existing holders to receive the airdrop and preventing new addresses from receiving tokens.
